<!--
  Shared LaTeX macros for the whole book.
  Included at the top of every .qmd via:  {{< include _macros.qmd >}}
  (chapters in subfolders use:            {{< include ../../_macros.qmd >}})

  How it works per format:
  - The plain \providecommand lines below are parsed by pandoc, which
    registers the macros for math conversion (EPUB/MathML) and passes them
    through into the PDF's LaTeX source. \providecommand is used (not
    \newcommand) because the PDF book is one document — the include runs
    once per chapter, and \providecommand safely no-ops when the macro
    is already defined.
  - The {=html} block is emitted only in HTML output, where MathJax
    executes the \newcommands inside the hidden math and registers them
    for the whole page.
  Add new macros in BOTH places below.
-->

\providecommand{\R}{\mathbb{R}}
\providecommand{\E}{\mathbb{E}}
\providecommand{\softmax}{\mathrm{softmax}}
\providecommand{\attention}{\mathrm{attention}}

```{=html}
<div style="display:none">
$$
\newcommand{\R}{\mathbb{R}}
\newcommand{\E}{\mathbb{E}}
\newcommand{\softmax}{\mathrm{softmax}}
\newcommand{\attention}{\mathrm{attention}}
$$
</div>
```
